question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The word **"Complimentery"** is incorrectly spelt.
 
• **​**The correct spelling is **"Complimentary"**.
 
 
• **Meaning:** Expressing a compliment; praising or approving. (प्रशंसा करने वाला)
 
• **Example:** She received many **complimentary **remarks about her performance.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Impertinent** (अशिष्ट): Not showing proper respect; rude.

 
 
• **Example:** His **impertinent **behaviour at the meeting was shocking to everyone.
 
 
 
• **Unreasonable** (अविवेकपूर्ण): Not guided by or based on good sense.
 
 
• **Example:** It is **unreasonable **to expect a child to sit still for hours.
 
 
 
• **Despondent** (निराश): In low spirits from loss of hope or courage.
 
 
• **Example:** She felt **despondent **after failing her exams.
